items.question: Have subsequent events been reviewed up to the date of the auditor's report, with any adjusting or disclosable events dealt with?
Has the going concern conclusion been documented, including any material uncertainty and its disclosure?
Has a signed management representation letter been obtained, dated no later than the report date?
Has final analytical review been performed to confirm the financial statements are consistent with the team's understanding of the entity?
Have the financial statements been checked for compliance with the applicable framework, including the disclosure checklist?
Has the form of audit opinion been determined, and any modification, emphasis of matter or other matter paragraph justified?
Have significant findings been communicated to those charged with governance?
Has the engagement partner reviewed the file and confirmed sufficient appropriate evidence has been obtained for the opinion?
Where an engagement quality review is required, has the reviewer completed the review before the report is dated?
Has the final file been assembled within the firm's deadline after the report date, and the assembly date recorded?
